body.x: Samsung Electronics introduced its IoT open platform ARTIK at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

ARTICK combines software, driver, storage, security solution, development mode, and cloud into one. It is a micro-sized IoT module made of a processor, memory, data transmission, and sensor. It is supplied through an electronic parts distributor Digi-key, and the partner program called Certified ARTIK Partner Program(CAPP) comes along with it.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
